workingTreeCandidate.scope: Domestic stability phase 1: structured operation diagnostics, chat group-model snapshot validation, single image queue executor hardening, async image reconciliation, account-scoped Skills selection, video job contract routing, local-material failure separation, and speech-recognition error classification.

knownLimitations: 3.0.37 was built from the clean source commit 453df15c5e58858e930ca65031bcc8e622675836. The domestic Direct APK is a test candidate, not a production release.

Toolchain doctor, TypeScript, documentation checks, 98 focused Jest tests, Direct Firebase validation, offline Gradle signing, artifact packaging and independent signature/upgrade-eligibility verification passed. No deployment, Play artifact or production publication occurred.

The client now falls back to the existing synchronous Images endpoint only when the async endpoint explicitly rejects the request before task admission, and it restores an already accepted image task without replaying a billable request. This does not make an upstream image account schedulable.

Read-only account diagnostics confirmed workspace groups video视频 (45) and Grok Heavy (65), including their returned models and purpose=video session switching. The historical mobile bootstrap payload was incomplete for group 45, so 3.0.36 no longer uses that optional metadata as a membership or routing allow-list: it calls the selected group-bound gateway session. No server-side group, price, account or billing configuration was changed in this client-only candidate; the final provider result remains a real-device check.

Real-device acceptance remains required for image queue continuation after a provider failure, blocked-login/balance recovery, local-material single-file recovery, video-project shot submission/reconciliation, package import/export, and all four languages.
